Name: IdaIda's Seasonal Gothic Buildings (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
[color=#b4a7d6]This mod replaces the vanilla farm buildings with new goth aesthetic. The colors should work well with vanilla and world recolors. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10491]
[/url]This mod includes all farm buildings and all cabins. All the buildings except the cabins and obelisks also change with the seasons. 

All the sprites in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.

This mod took a really long time and a lot of love to make, so I hope you will enjoy it too.
[/color]
